statement.name: getProcInst
statement.sql:
select fpi.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join Workflow.dbo.FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi on fic.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id
12

statement.name: getProcInstThruApp
statement.sql:
select distinct fpi.* from Workflow.dbo.PROCESS_INSTANCE_CONTEXT fic inner join APPLICATIONS app on fic.object_id = cast(la.applicationid as varchar(36)) inner join Workflow.dbo.FACT_PROCESS_INSTANCE fpi on fic.process_instance_id = fpi.process_instance_id
11
